sn35.66:1.2: kittāvatā nu kho bhante, satto vā assa sattapaññatti vāti? yattha kho samiddhi atthi cakkhu, atthi rūpā, atthi cakkhuviññāṇaṃ, atthi cakkhuviññāṇaviññātabbā dhammā, atthi tattha satto vā sattapaññatti vā. …pe…
sn35.66:1.3: atthi jivhā, atthi rasā, atthi jivhāviññāṇaṃ, atthi jivhāviññāṇaviññātabbā dhammā, atthi tattha satto vā sattapaññatti vā. …pe… atthi mano, atthi dhammā, atthi manoviññāṇaṃ, atthi manoviññāṇaviññātabbā dhammā, atthi tattha satto vā sattapaññatti vā. yattha ca kho samiddhi natthi cakkhu, natthi rūpā, natthi cakkhuviññāṇaṃ, natthi cakkhuviññāṇaviññātabbā dhammā, natthi tattha satto vā sattapaññatti vā. …pe… natthi jivhā, natthi rasā, natthi jivhāviññāṇaṃ, natthi jivhāviññāṇaviññātabbā dhammā, natthi tattha satto vā sattapaññatti vā. …pe… natthi mano, natthi dhammā, natthi manoviññāṇaṃ, natthi manoviññāṇaviññātabbā dhammā, natthi tattha satto vā sattapaññatti vāti.
